integrity: Unrestricted symbolic proof; accompanying regression checks sample finitely many prime pairs and exponent states. No independent audit or external certification.
scientific_limitations: Only two supported primes \(p<q\) with \(q\le p^p\). Does not assert cycles exist if \(q>p^p\), nor address larger prime sets. Published fixed points and {2,3} case are prior-covered. Independent validation is absent; novelty remains relative to inspected sources.
title: Prime-gap rigidity for arithmetic subderivative cycles
